name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's motorsport journey began in his youth, captivated by the technical brilliance of Formula One. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and simulation. His career started as a data analyst for a junior formula team, where his meticulous analysis and insightful strategies quickly gained attention.

He joined JHR Developments after several successful seasons with smaller teams. Kenji is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to distill complex data into actionable race strategies. His approach emphasizes precision, risk mitigation, and adapting to rapidly changing conditions. He is a firm believer in thorough preparation and constantly refines his models based on real-world performance.

Kenji's dedication to motorsport extends beyond race weekends; he spends countless hours studying historical races and researching innovative strategies. He's regarded as one of the most detail-oriented strategists in the paddock, a characteristic that makes him indispensable to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build and wears thin-rimmed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten race simulations.
Insists on having a specific type of green tea before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
